title: Bandar Abbas wind leads STNG (short 3d)
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Bandar Abbas max wind 20d z-score > 1 (rough seas suppress small-boat harassment, easing tanker risk premium) leads STNG log returns by 3 days (-); trade short STNG 3d [weather.bandar_abbas.wind_max -> finance.STNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0010)
message: Not supported: short-STNG-on-high-wind rule loses (23 trades, hit 35%, sharpe -2.25, war-test excess -2.7%); best lag 8d r=-0.08; actionability 0.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.bandar_abbas.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short STNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 8 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Reversal of R2-0112: Bandar Abbas max wind 20d z-score > 1 (rough seas delay Hormuz tanker transits, tightening product-tanker supply) leads STNG log returns by 5 days (+); trade long STNG 5d [weather.bandar_abbas.wind_max -> finance.STNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0112)
